target_audience: High school students or math enthusiasts

sections.title: The Flatlander’s Dilemma (Prerequisite)
lecture_lines: Imagine creatures living on a flat, 2D plane.
They cannot comprehend the 'up' or 'down' directions.
A cross-section is a slice of a higher dimension.
animations: Create a 2D plane labeled '2D World' in color #FFFFFF.
Animate 'up' and 'down' arrows with a red 'X' cross-out overlay to show they are invisible to Flatlanders. Color #FF0000.
Show a 3D sphere passing through the 2D plane, highlighting the circular cross-section slice. Color #00FFFF.

sections.title: Projection and Shadow Mechanics
lecture_lines: Shadows are a loss of 3D spatial information.
Rotating the object reveals its hidden internal structure.
animations: Fade in a 2D Square on a black #000000 background. Color #FFFFFF.
Show a line casting a 1D shadow on the square. Color #FFFF00.
Rotate the Square to show changing shadow lengths. Color #00FFFF.

sections.title: The Tesseract Puzzle: Unfolding 4D
lecture_lines: A cube unfolds into a 2D 'net' of squares.
A 4D Tesseract unfolds into eight connected 3D cubes.
This helps us visualize higher-dimensional spatial relationships.
We map 4D structures into our 3D space.
Complexity is simplified through dimensional unfolding.
animations: Display a 3D Cube, then flatten it into a 2D cross shape. Color #FFFFFF.
Show a 4D Tesseract structure with 8 cubes connected. Color #00FF00.
Animate the Tesseract unfolding into its 3D net. Color #FF00FF.
Overlay a coordinate grid to show mapping points. Color #888888.
Final static view of the full unfolded net. Color #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Application: The Dimensional Traveler
lecture_lines: A 3D shape passing through a 2D plane.
The plane only sees a changing 2D cross-section.
Reconstruct the full 3D shape from these slices.
Dimensional shifting reveals hidden patterns in data.
See the whole by studying its individual slices.
animations: A 3D Sphere passes through a 2D plane. Color #FFFFFF.
Show the intersection circle growing and shrinking on the plane. Color #FF0000.
Stack the resulting circles to reform the sphere. Color #0000FF.
Highlight the data path formed by the slices. Color #FFFF00.
Display the full sphere shape from the collected slices. Color #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Dimensional shifts translate hidden data into patterns.
What we perceive is often a limited slice.
animations: Display a nested series of points, lines, squares, and cubes. Color #FFFFFF.
Animate arrows pointing from lower to higher dimensions. Color #FF00FF.
Final fade out of the sequence, leaving only a single point. Color #888888.
